description.subject: A crocheted yarn doll with a cream-coloured head, black bead eyes and a stitched smile, standing upright.
description.covering: A red crocheted hooded duffle jacket with cream fur-like trim at the hood, cuffs and hem, closed with two brass toggle fasteners, over teal knitted leggings with red and cream stripes at the shins and mustard-coloured knitted boots.
description.posture: It stands straight on both feet with its sleeves hanging at its sides, facing the camera directly.
description.setting: A plain seamless studio surface in pale silver tone, with a loose coil of thick silvery rope-like yarn, five peach-coloured wooden beads, two speckled wooden beads and two flat lemon-coloured buttons scattered around its feet.
description.light: Soft, diffuse, even illumination from the front and above in a neutral cool tone, casting only faint shadows beneath the figure.
description.anomaly: Two brass toggle fasteners on the front of the jacket, each held by a flat disc button with a tiny smiley face stamped on it, plus a tuft of fluffy cream fibre stuck to the red jacket front.
